nodes.label: FN-DSA (Falcon) Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST PQC standardized lattice-based digital signature algorithm based on the NTRU lattice framework and Fast Fourier Sampling over algebraic number fields.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Dynamic Capacity Device (DCD) Subsystem
nodes.description: CXL 3.1 memory expansion architecture allowing granular, runtime allocation and deallocation of non-contiguous physical memory blocks to hosts without rebooting.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Arabic Named Entity Recognition (NER) Pipeline
nodes.description: Contextual sequence labeling subsystem in CAMeL Tools identifying named entity types (PER, LOC, ORG) in MSA and dialectal Arabic text using transformer-based embeddings.

nodes.label: W3C SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) Standard Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a language for validating RDF graphs against a set of structural, cardinality, and value domain conditions (NodeShapes and PropertyShapes).

nodes.label: Min-Plus (Tropical Arithmetic) Semiring in GraphBLAS
nodes.description: Algebraic semiring structure where addition is replaced by min and multiplication is replaced by addition, enabling single-source shortest path (SSSP) algorithms on weighted graphs.
